title: test_dashboard_loading_performance_and_data_accuracy
description: Verify that the dashboard loads within 3 seconds and displays updated data including balance, recent transactions, categories, saving goals, and credit card debt.

title: test_create_transaction_with_validations_and_currency_conversion
description: Test creating a transaction with positive amounts, correct types, and automatic multi-currency conversion for ARS, USD, EUR, and BRL.

title: test_category_management_uniqueness_and_effect_on_transactions
description: Ensure categories are unique per user and that creating, editing, deactivating, or deleting categories correctly affects associated transactions.

title: test_payment_methods_management_and_usage_statistics
description: Validate CRUD operations on payment methods and verify usage statistics are correctly updated and displayed.

title: test_saving_goals_progress_tracking_and_state_changes
description: Check that saving goals track progress visually, update progress bars and charts, and change state when completed.

title: test_credit_card_summary_payment_creates_transaction_and_updates_status
description: Verify that paying a credit card summary creates the corresponding transaction and updates payment status and dates correctly.

title: test_pending_payments_filters_and_priority_handling
description: Test filtering pending payments by overdue and upcoming due dates and verify priority handling in the list.

title: test_financial_agent_ia_response_and_function_calling
description: Validate that the financial AI agent responds in natural language, calls backend functions correctly, and provides dynamic financial insights.

title: test_bulk_transaction_upload_with_validation_and_preview
description: Test uploading a CSV file with multiple transactions, validate each row, show a preview, and confirm import with error handling.

title: test_authentication_oauth2_jwt_and_multi_tenancy_security
description: Verify secure user authentication using OAuth2 and JWT, ensuring multi-tenancy data isolation and protection against SQL injection.
